FROM <https://omnix.dev/graphs/demo-tenant/kg/events-sf>

  ?event <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <https://omnix.dev/types/Event>.

question: For complaints filed via Web from California, what percentage have the 'Older American' tag?
